playstyle: Anchor the group, then feed it. Keep the psalm up and keep the party inside 10 m: with a priest in the group the flask is dead weight, and the fight turns on whether the line stays together. Spend the mana well on the two casters, hold the bulwark for the push, and keep the revival for the moment the war is already decided.

abilities.name: Quiet Rest
abilities.notes: The priest rests: 60 HP (+0.5 per WIS) over 6 s while standing still and taking no damage. Any hit cancels it and refunds nothing. Free of mana on purpose: the priest is never mana-starved, only dead.

abilities.name: Cheer Song
abilities.notes: +12% move speed and +30% stamina regeneration for 15 s for the priest and every ally within 6 m. Baseline kit of the acolyte branch; the priest keeps it and builds on it.

abilities.name: Psalm of the Open Hand
abilities.notes: The flask replacement. A 10 m circle anchored on the priest, 20 s. Every 1.0 s: 12 HP (+0.5 per WIS) and 6 MP to every ally inside. Re-cast refreshes the 20 s, 12 s cooldown from the start, so it can be held forever for 25 mana a cycle. While the psalm runs the priest deals half damage; it stops the moment the priest dies or leaves the circle. There is no instant full heal anywhere in this kit.

abilities.name: Well of Quiet
abilities.notes: The priest pays 40 mana up front; every ally within 8 m gains 120 MP over 4 s. The priest gains none of it. One priest feeds two casters and still comes out ahead of the pool it started with.

abilities.name: Hymn of the Bulwark
abilities.notes: -20% damage taken for 8 s for the priest and every ally within 8 m. The bulwark is the whole party answer to one big hit; it does not stop damage over time, only the swing that lands while it runs.

abilities.name: Verse of the Steadfast Watch
abilities.notes: +20% attack speed and +10% cast speed for 10 s for every ally within 10 m. Casters in the circle get their rotation back, fighters get their swings back; the priest gets neither.

abilities.name: Chastisement
abilities.notes: A thrown light on one enemy within 24 m: 70 (+0.4 per WIS) damage and a 30% slow for 3 s. The priest's only damage. It exists to hold a runner still for the line, not to kill anyone.

abilities.name: Hymn of Return
abilities.notes: The revival. It must be started on the fallen ally's tomb marker, and the marker must be within 30 m; no marker, no revive. 6 s channel, interrupted by damage. The ally returns with 25% HP, 50% MP and one debuff stripped, and loses 25% of the XP they need for their next level. 420 s cooldown.

abilities.name: Unbroken Choir
abilities.notes: Strips two debuffs from every ally within 8 m, one per ally, the second only if the first lands. The priest's own debuffs are stripped too. A cleanse, never a heal: it does not give health back.

abilities.name: Chorus of the Vanguard
abilities.notes: The payoff. A 12 m circle for 12 s: +20% damage dealt for every ally inside and 8 HP (+0.5 per WIS) per second of regen for them. The group hits harder and does not run dry while the chorus runs. 180 s cooldown, 100 mana.

weakness: Almost no damage of its own: 70 per cast, and half of that while the psalm runs. Every support cast has a 0.6 to 1.0 s open and the priest has no gap closer, so one assassin who reaches the priest ends the sustain. The kit also needs the party packed inside 10 m: a group that spreads loses the psalm, the bulwark and the chorus at once.
